description: Notify via desktop (notify-send) and tmux bell when Claude finishes or needs attention

hooks.command: command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1 && notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Claude finished'; [ -n "$TMUX" ] && printf '\a' > "$(tmux display-message -p '#{pane_tty}')"
command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1 && notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Claude needs your attention'; [ -n "$TMUX" ] && printf '\a' > "$(tmux display-message -p '#{pane_tty}')"
